summary: Re-reviewed the exact rebased head and the three P1 closures: incident-write failure retries before in-memory paging is latched; released and failed protection state survives a new OMS process through the entry-order payload; the independent net enumerates open managed rows from the database. Read transaction boundaries and pager source coverage, ran 151 focused tests plus ruff, and independently proved removing durable released-state recognition makes the restart control fail.
